records.name: Super Spirit Bomb
records.character_source: Goku; Goku (Super Saiyan God); Goku (GT); Goku (Super Saiyan 4) (Customize Partner); Cell (Perfect); Cell (Full Power)
records.acquisition: Expert Mission 16 — In the Realm of the Gods: Vegeta
records.evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation identifies Super Spirit Bomb as a 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate and explicitly associates it with EM16. The repository's EM endpoint layer and independent historical reward guide both identify it as the EM16 skill reward.
records.mechanics: Large tracked Spirit Bomb projectile with a long startup; current dedicated evidence describes 14 hits and approximately 85% total damage. The damage figure is retained as source-described mechanics, not as a version-independent canonical damage value.
limits: Exact per-clear drop probability and first-clear guarantee remain unresolved.
No Ultimate Finish-only requirement is inferred.
The Festival variant added in later versions is distinct and is not merged into this canonical EM16 record.

records.name: Spirit Sword
records.acquisition: Expert Mission 17 — In the Realm of the Gods: Goku
records.evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation identifies Spirit Sword as a 400-Ki Strike Ultimate and explicitly associates it with EM17. The repository's EM endpoint layer and independent historical reward guide identify it as the EM17 skill reward.
records.mechanics: Long Ki-blade thrust followed by two spinning slashes; current dedicated evidence describes 3 hits, knockback, and approximately 50% total damage. The damage figure is retained as source-described mechanics, not as a version-independent canonical damage value.
limits: Exact per-clear drop probability and first-clear guarantee remain unresolved.
No Ultimate Finish-only requirement is inferred.

Historical sources sometimes call the EM17 reward Spirit Bomb/Spirit Sword; current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and the repository canonical endpoint resolve the skill identity as Spirit Sword.

evidence_boundary: This batch consolidates current Xenoverse 2-specific skill pages, the repository's existing EM16-17 endpoint/evidence layers, and independent reward documentation. It does not infer probabilities, guarantees, frame data, or version-independent damage. The EM17 historical naming discrepancy is preserved as provenance rather than treated as a second skill.
